phase: ROADMAP Stage 6 (fourth item): model-provider data-flow disclosure + risk grading skeleton v1 (offline low, external escalates by data-flow flags; no real provider integration)
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 6 provider data-flow disclosure + risk grading skeleton. build_provider_profile records provider_id/mode/endpoint_type/data categories/storage/training/residency/retention metadata (local modes send nothing off-machine) and never stores an api key, token, or endpoint URL. build_provider_disclosure produces user-facing text/structured object explaining what may be sent before model use. grade_provider_risk deterministically rates low/medium/high/blocked from flags (local=low, unknown mode=blocked, external escalates by external egress, sensitive categories, storage, training, and unknown residency). validate_provider_profile rejects credential-shaped fields and unsupported mode/categories. build_provider_risk_summary bundles profile+disclosure+risk. HTTP GET /api/providers/risk and POST /api/providers/risk/grade; a front-end 设置 panel section surfaces the disclosure + grade. No real provider integration, no network, no credential/.env read.
implemented: backend/server.py: added PROVIDER_MODES, PROVIDER_MODES_LOCAL, PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_TYPES, PROVIDER_DATA_CATEGORIES, PROVIDER_SENSITIVE_CATEGORIES, PROVIDER_RISK_LEVELS, PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN_FIELDS.
backend/server.py: build_provider_profile(options=None) (method=provider_profile_v1; local modes drop all off-machine categories/flags; never carries credentials).
backend/server.py: build_provider_disclosure(profile) (method=provider_disclosure_v1; local vs external user-facing text + structured fields).
backend/server.py: grade_provider_risk(profile) (deterministic low/medium/high/blocked with score, reasons, factors; invalid/unknown mode -> blocked).
backend/server.py: validate_provider_profile(profile) (rejects api_key/token/secret/endpoint_url... and unsupported mode/endpoint_type/categories; warns external-without-categories).
backend/server.py: Handler.do_GET serves GET /api/providers/risk; do_POST serves POST /api/providers/risk/grade (422 when the posted profile fails validation).
frontend/index.html + app.js: 设置 panel provider-risk section with #loadProviderRiskBtn/#providerRiskStatus/#providerDisclosure and loadProviderRisk() calling /api/providers/risk.

tests/test_provider_risk.py: 24 tests (offline low + no egress, external prompt-only medium, sensitive+store+train high, unknown blocked, no-credential-leak, disclosure content, validation rejections, live HTTP risk/grade, frontend tokens).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_provider_risk.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; only the ROADMAP '模型供应商数据流提示与风险分级' item is marked done (dependency-lock/SBOM/container untouched).

python -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 413 tests OK.

risks: The risk grade is a deterministic heuristic over declared flags, not a legal/compliance assessment; a provider that lies about storage/training would be under-graded. It informs a human decision, it does not certify safety.
Risk grading trusts the caller-supplied profile; there is no verification that the declared mode/endpoint/categories match the provider's actual behavior.
The scoring thresholds (>=5 high, >=2 medium) are fixed and coarse; they are a starting policy, not a calibrated risk model.
Disclosure text is generated from the profile only; if a category is omitted from the profile it will be omitted from the disclosure (validation warns for external-without-categories).

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; provider profile builder omits and validator rejects api_key/token/secret/password/authorization/endpoint_url.
No external network calls were used for implementation or local tests; no provider is actually contacted.
No push performed; commit/push left to the maintainer.
